ids.description: A list of collection request, response, or folder UIDs to transfer.

target.description: Information about the item transfer's destination location.

location.description:
The transferred items' placement in the target destination:
- For `start` or `end` — Do not include the `model` and `id` values.
- For `before` or `after` — Include the `model` and `id` properties.

id.description: For `before` or `after` positions, the model's UID.

model.description: For `before` or `after` positions, the type of item (model) that the transferred item will be positioned by. One of: `folder`, `request`, or `response.`

position.description: The transferred item's position within the destination object.
